notes: Owner build only: Claret Flint and Roxy Ifrita Pryce of Flint Workshop join Roscaelifer, researched through the wiki (profiles, lore, dialogue, DMs), Google AI Mode and your measurements sheet.

Claret is the proud, tsundere head of the Flint family and Roscaelifer's biggest creditor. She is a dessert snob with a blown budget, a terrible morning person, and is chasing a way to forge Porcelloy without Flint blood.
Roxy is her deadpan, insomniac right hand: she tracks Milady's every expense, works until 3 AM (Vyrium's "late-night stalker" legend) and carries a coffin. Her Porcelloy heart runs on Claret's blood.

Both live on Vyrium island with their own schedules: forge hours, Wednesday budget fights, Roxy's Thursday debt collecting at CCD Square, Saturday pancakes. They cross paths with Lindverne, Velina and the others.
